title: The lead that books itself

steps.label: New Enquiry
steps.say: A new enquiry just landed on your website. It's 9:47 at night.

steps.label: AI Agent
steps.say: Before anyone on your team sees it, an AI agent reads it, checks the fit, and scores it.

steps.label: Ready to buy?
steps.say: Ready buyers go one way. Early browsers go into a gentle nurture sequence, so nobody gets dropped.

steps.label: Create Contact
steps.say: Your CRM is updated with everything. No copy and paste.

steps.label: Personal Reply
steps.say: Within a minute, Daniel gets a personal reply about the exact home he asked about.

card.message: Hi Daniel, thanks for asking about 14 Oak Avenue. Yes, it's still available. Inspections run Saturday 10:30 and Tuesday 5:30.

steps.label: Alert Agent
steps.say: He books, and your agent gets a message with the full story before the inspection starts.

overview_say: Every step, running on its own, day and night, while your team works on the deals that matter.

stat.say: Say twenty enquiries a week at fifteen minutes each. That is five hours back, every week.

caption: An enquiry lands at 9:47 pm. By morning, the inspection is booked.
